text:
mira: Idea: add a tiny 'Cost Peek' badge to the route list that flags token burn spikes and shows top 3 contributing model SKUs. Click => lightweight modal with sample_count, estimated cache savings, and CSV export. Low risk, high signal.

 dan: Nice. How do we detect spikes? rolling median + 3x? we need to avoid false positives for bursty routes.

mira: Thinking spike = >3x baseline where baseline is median over last 24h at same hour-of-day bucket. Keep it simple initially. Label confidence: low/med/high based on sample_count.

oliver: Sampling/telemetry Q: do we emit new events or reuse token-level ingest? I want to avoid extra SLO pressure.

tessa: We can reuse existing token_telemetry but add a compact indexer job that samples 1 per 100 requests and writes small aggregates to metrics store. No new high-cardinality events.

sam: Permissions: we mustn't show tenant-level $ numbers to everyone. Suggest: badge + percent delta publicly, full $ + CSV only to billing/admin roles. Also note GDPR: CSV may contain customer identifiers, redact by default.

mira: Agreed. Default CSV fields: route_gv, model_sku, token_count_est, cache_hit_rate_est (pct), sample_count, confidence_label. No customer emails/PII.

dan: API shape proposal for modal: GET /internal/cost-peek?route_gv=...&window=1h returns {percent_delta, sample_count, confidence, top_models}. Keep payload tiny.

oliver: Let's lock down auth: console service acct only, plus rate limit 10 rps/org. Also cache results server-side for 10 min to avoid repeat compute.

tessa: Backend estimator notes: prefer forward-only incremental aggregates. Use reservoir sampling to keep recent examples for bootstrapping hit ratio. Keep TTL 6h for buckets.

sam: Alerting: optionally convert high-confidence spike to alert in eng-sre with a one-click acknowledge. But default should be just cosmetic for 24h.

mira: UX: small color-coded dot (green/amber/red) on rows + hover shows quick numbers. Modal has a tiny chart sparkline (15min), top 3 SKUs, and export button.

dan: Edgecases: very low-volume route (<30 samples) should never surface red; show 'insufficient data' instead.

oliver: Implementation plan: 1) tessa proto aggregator job + metrics table; 2) dan add API endpoint + cache; 3) mira/jules (I'll ask jules in design) wireframe + CSV columns; 4) sam add RBAC for export.

ops-bot: ticket created: PERF-1129 "cost-peek-badge-and-modal" assigned to tessa,dan,mira,sam.

tessa: Rollout: feature-flag roll to internal canaries first, then 10% orgs for 48h, monitor `cost_peek_render` and `cost_peek_export` events.

dan: Quick note on instrumentation: emit `cost_peek_sample` with route_gv, sample_count, baseline, current_window. Everything low-cardinality strings + ints.

mira: microcopy: tooltip for confidence: "Confidence reflects sample size and variability. Estimates are approximate." will put in design doc.

sam: CSV retention policy: exports logged but actual CSV content not stored by service; only audit rows kept for 30d.

oliver: One more: add a prom alert if `cost_peek_aggregate_lag` > 5m so we know indexing job fell behind.

tessa: Noted. Anything else? sync tomorrow 11am to land initial proto.

mira: Thanks, all :rocket:
